Hi Glen,

You're right, nothing has shipped yet, and I'm sorry. Here's where both of your open orders stand.

Magic M. 40T (order Shop····): all 300 units of this production run are on their way to our warehouses. Your miner ships November 30, and we'll email you the tracking number the moment it leaves.

Harlo B30 and Power K. (order Shop····): we told you this would ship by November 15. That date has passed, and I'm sorry. Your Power K. is already set aside at our Tennessee warehouse. The B30s are arriving there now and being checked in, and yours goes out in the same box as soon as it's ready. I don't want to give you a date we can't keep, so I've asked a colleague to confirm your B30's ship date. They'll reply to you here with it.

You can follow the shipments on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking for both orders will go to (email hidden) Some of our emails have been landing in spam, so it's worth checking there too.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
